title: Bronco II
subtitle: Ford Bronco · 1984–1990

tiles.label: CHASSIS
tiles.text: Ladder frame · 94 in wheelbase · 56.9 in track

tiles.label: FRONT SUSPENSION
tiles.text: Twin Traction Beam, coil springs, radius arms

buy: Facelift to match the Ranger: new hood, fenders, bumper and dashboard, 161.9 in long
avoid: Fuel-injected 2.9 Cologne V6 (140 hp); Mitsubishi 2.3 turbodiesel offered; Touch-Drive electric-shift…
checks: Look for a cracked 2.9 head before anything else
Hunt for water leaks and cowl rust
Judge the A4LD, especially on 1985–87 trucks
Read the door sticker and the front axle
owner: Ford put a roof on the new Ranger, cut the wheelbase to 94 inches and sold more than 760,000 of the result.
